summary: Completed frontend-only e2e testing of LaundryMax Production Scanner (Segment 2) on mobile viewport 420x900. All 9 required flows verified and passing: navigation cashier→production via goto-production-button, back-to-cashier-button returns to /, all 4 stations (WASH/DRY/IRON/PACK) render in 2x2 grid and are clickable, scanner-modal opens with scanner-viewport + animated scanner-line visible, auto-close after ~1.5s with sonner toast matching /Order LND-\d+ Status Updated!/, new row prepended to recent-scans-list with correct station label badge, cancel-scan-button closes modal immediately with NO success toast and NO new row, initial 5 mocked orders (LND-001..LND-005) with correct colored badges (IRON/DRY/WASH/PACK/READY), active-orders-count correctly shows 4 initially (non-READY) and increments after scan, Cashier POS remains fully functional after round-trip. Captured toast example: 'Order LND-671 Status Updated!'.

issues: A11y warning in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Radix Dialog recommends either a DialogDescription child or aria-describedby on DialogContent. Non-blocking but should be addressed for accessibility compliance.

action_items: (Optional/a11y) Add a DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to DialogContent in ProductionScanner.jsx scanner-modal and POSScreen.jsx photo/QR dialogs to silence Radix a11y warning.
(Optional, carryover from iteration_1) Typo 'AMBIL FOTO CUCIAAN' → 'AMBIL FOTO CUCIAN' in POSScreen.jsx photo-upload-button label.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductionScanner.jsx (~375 lines) is cohesive and readable — no split needed yet.
Scanner flow is entirely client-side MOCKED via setTimeout(1500) generating random LND-### IDs and prepending to local state. Confirmed per problem statement — no real QR/camera.
timerRef is correctly cleaned up in useEffect unmount cleanup AND in handleCloseModal when modal closes early — good race-condition handling; cancel path correctly prevents the toast + state update.

Random order ID range Math.floor(Math.random()*900)+100 gives 100..999 — could theoretically collide with seeded IDs (LND-001..005 are outside this range, so safe) but not unique long-term. Acceptable for MVP mock.
active-orders-count derives from recentScans filter — correct and reactive.
Sonner toast is themed correctly (#FFD700 on #1A1A1A, top-center) per spec.
seed_data_creation: None (initial scans are hardcoded in ProductionScanner.jsx)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Segment 2 Production Scanner verified on /production. Key testids: production-scanner, production-header, production-title, back-to-cashier-button, active-orders-count, station-grid, station-wash/dry/iron/pack, recent-scans-list, scan-row-{id}, status-badge-{id}, scanner-modal, scanner-viewport, scanner-line, cancel-scan-button. Nav from Cashier uses goto-production-button. Scanner auto-confirms in exactly 1500ms, prepending a new row with random LND-XXX id and station label as status. Cancel via cancel-scan-button cleanly aborts the timer. Toast matches /Order LND-\d+ Status Updated!/ regex. Mobile viewport 420x900 recommended.
